FACT_ID: sec10-R01 | anchor: A41
Three seconds of warning is the floor, yet a blinker fired before the driveways and crossings ahead lies to entering drivers, so count down early but commit late. [A41]
Why it matters: group_hint signal-timing; prereq_hint sec10-F02; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec10-F02, sec10-F03.
Source: [A41 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0041]
FACT_ID: sec10-R02 | anchor: A41
A forgotten blinker after a soft turn reads as a second turn coming, unlike a deliberate hold through the maneuver, so eyes must confirm the cancel each time. [A41]
Why it matters: group_hint signal-cancel; prereq_hint sec10-F04; difficulty_hint 1; confusable_with sec10-F04, sec10-F01.
Source: [A41 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0041]
FACT_ID: sec10-R03 | anchor: A41
Routine slowdowns speak through steady brake lamps, while surprise halts demand three or four quick taps, and mixing the two leaves followers guessing. [A41]
Why it matters: group_hint warn-levels; prereq_hint sec10-F05; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec10-F05.
Source: [A41 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0041]
FACT_ID: sec10-R04 | anchor: A41
Dead brakes want pumping, then gentle parking brake, then lower gears, while a blown tire wants a locked line, lifted gas and feathered brakes — pumping the wrong fault wastes the rescue. [A41]
Why it matters: group_hint fault-response; prereq_hint sec10-F08; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec10-F08, sec10-F09.
Source: [A41 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0041]
FACT_ID: sec10-R05 | anchor: A42
Antilock pedals beg to be pinned through their shudder, while plain brakes punish the same stomp with a skid that only a quick lift and re-press can cure. [A42]
Why it matters: group_hint stop-systems; prereq_hint sec10-F15; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec10-F15, sec10-F16.
Source: [A42 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0042]
FACT_ID: sec10-R06 | anchor: A42
With antilock help the wheel may turn mid-braking, but without it the driver must brake, release, then steer, since locked fronts only plow straight. [A42]
Why it matters: group_hint turn-systems; prereq_hint sec10-F17; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec10-F17, sec10-F18.
Source: [A42 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0042]
FACT_ID: sec10-R07 | anchor: A42
A sliding car ignores the brake and slides further for it, so feet lift while hands steer and counter-steer, the reverse of every dry-road instinct. [A42]
Why it matters: group_hint skid-reverse; prereq_hint sec10-F21; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec10-F21, sec10-F20.
Source: [A42 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0042]
FACT_ID: sec10-R08 | anchor: A42
Forward gas rescues only a side or rear threat with open road ahead, everywhere else the triad ranks stopping and turning first, and speed as the rare third door. [A42]
Why it matters: group_hint escape-triad; prereq_hint sec10-F14; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec10-F14, sec10-F19.
Source: [A42 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0042]
FACT_ID: sec10-R09 | anchor: A43
Rear blows pin you back with brakes set, side blows lean on belts alone past useless front bags, and frontal blows beg a twist toward the glance — one brace never fits all three. [A43]
Why it matters: group_hint hit-sides; prereq_hint sec10-F25; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec10-F25, sec10-F26, sec10-F27.
Source: [A43 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0043]
FACT_ID: sec10-R10 | anchor: A43
The injured stay put unless fire or traffic hunts them, and the crash itself always halts you, though officers need calling only for hurt, killed or broken property. [A43]
Why it matters: group_hint scene-rules; prereq_hint sec10-F29; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec10-F29, sec10-F23, sec10-F30.
Source: [A43 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0043]
